text: Artificial intelligence is transforming our world, but it also brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias: if an AI system learns from biased data, it can make unfair decisions, for example in hiring or lending. Fairness means we must actively check and correct these patterns. Privacy is another issue, since AI often uses personal information, and people need to know how their data is being handled. Transparency is equally important—users should understand why an AI made a particular decision. Ultimately, responsible AI development means putting human values first, involving diverse teams, and continuously reviewing systems to ensure they serve everyone justly and safely.
